input.contentHtml:
Preparing for your puppy

Preparing for your puppy starts with a calm place to rest. Set up a sleeping space before your puppy arrives.

A comfortable first night

Keep water close by. Give your puppy time to settle. A familiar blanket can help. Stay nearby and use a quiet voice.

Food and routine

Use the same food for the first few days. Make changes slowly. Ask your vet about portions and keep fresh water available.

Getting outside

Check that the garden gate closes. Take short trips outside after meals and naps. Praise calm behavior and allow plenty of rest.

Read our care sheet and speak with your vet about the right vaccination schedule.

input.contentHtml:
Puppy care at home

Puppy care at home begins with a quiet bed and fresh water. Plan short walks and regular meals.

A calm routine

Allow time for rest. Ask your vet about safe exercise.

Read our care guide

Give your new companion a quiet place to sleep. Place the bed where your family spends time, away from busy doors. Keep a clean bowl nearby and check it throughout the day. Before the first night, walk through the house and put loose cables out of reach. Ask everyone to leave shoes and small toys in closed cupboards.

Plan a gentle routine with time outside after meals and naps. Stay close during the first few outings. Reward calm behavior and allow time to explore. Take a familiar blanket on the journey home. Let your new friend approach people at a comfortable pace. Keep introductions brief and allow long breaks for sleep.

Talk with your vet about health checks and the next vaccination appointment. Keep the food familiar for the first few days and make any changes slowly. Save the care sheet so everyone follows the same routine. If you are unsure about anything, contact us. We want families to feel prepared and welcome questions about the first weeks together.
